content.en: **Animal husbandry** plays a foundational role in the **Indian Economy**, serving as a crucial sub-sector of agriculture (GS-3). It encompasses cattle, dairy farming, poultry, sheep, goat, and piggery management. The sector provides sustainable livelihood options to millions of rural households, particularly landless, small, and marginal farmers.
